turns.sentence: Is it always this cold in winter here?
Yes, usually from December to March.
I should buy a warmer jacket then.
Good idea, and some boots too.
We're organizing a community cleanup this Saturday — would you be interested in joining?
I'd love to, actually — I've been meaning to get more involved in the neighborhood.
Great! We meet at the community center at nine, and lunch is provided afterward.
Perfect, should I bring my own gloves and tools?
We'll have extras on hand, but feel free to bring your own if you prefer.
I'm still trying to wrap my head around how the healthcare system works here compared to back home.
It takes some getting used to — once you have your health card, most visits to a family doctor are covered.
And what about specialists — do I need a referral, or can I book directly?
You'll generally need a referral from your family doctor first, though wait times can vary quite a bit.
Good to know — I'll make sure to register with a family doctor as soon as possible.
